description: This Java class 'TechDataServices' provides various utility methods related to manufacturing technical data, including retrieval and validation of routing tasks, calendar management, capacity calculations, and date adjustments within a manufacturing context.

classes.name: TechDataServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services related to manufacturing tech data, including routing task lookup, calendar management, capacity calculations, and date adjustments.

methods.name: lookupRoutingTask
methods.description: Retrieves routing tasks filtered by name or machine group, ordered by name, with specific status and type filters.

methods.name: checkRoutingTaskAssoc
methods.description: Checks for conflicting routing task associations with overlapping periods and sequence numbers.

methods.name: getTechDataCalendar
methods.description: Fetches the TechDataCalendar associated with a routing task, defaulting if none is found.

methods.name: dayStartCapacityAvailable
methods.description: Finds the first day in a week where capacity is available starting from a given day.

methods.name: capacityRemaining
methods.description: Calculates remaining capacity in a calendar period from a specific date.

methods.name: startNextDay
methods.description: Finds the start of the next available day in the calendar along with its capacity.

methods.name: dayEndCapacityAvailable
methods.description: Finds the last day in a week where capacity is available ending at a given day.

methods.name: capacityRemainingBackward
methods.description: Calculates remaining capacity backward from a specific date.

methods.name: endPreviousDay
methods.description: Finds the end of the previous available day in the calendar along with its capacity.

methods.name: addForward
methods.description: Moves forward in time within a calendar, respecting available periods.

methods.name: addBackward
methods.description: Moves backward in time within a calendar, respecting available periods.
